title: servers.member_banned
description: MemberBanned is published when a member is banned from a server. The same transaction also publishes membership.MemberLeft, so consumers that only track membership don't need to know about bans.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

banned_by.description: Usuario (owner, administrador o moderador con BAN_MEMBERS) que ejecutó el ban.
